description: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cuota de energías renovables en el consumo final bruto de energía por ; Avifauna y tendidos eléctricos; Sensibilidad renovables. Energía eólica y Energía Fotovoltaica; Indicadores municipales de sostenibilidad: Superficie solar térmica in. Formats seen: CSV, PDF, SHEET, API, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
